test_cases.summary:
Verify Fast filtering
when large dataset
test_cases.description:
Feature: Search Performance
Scenario: Fast filtering
Given large dataset
When searching
Then results should load within acceptable SLA
test_cases.acceptance:
Results should load within acceptable SLA
The behavior should be validated when searching.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Repeated searches
when user performs multiple searches consecutively
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multiple Searches Stability
Scenario: Repeated searches
Given user performs multiple searches consecutively
When grid updates repeatedly
Then no crash or memory leak should occur
test_cases.acceptance:
No crash or memory leak should occur
The behavior should be validated when grid updates repeatedly.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Show empty state when no results found
when filters/search return zero results
test_cases.description:
Feature: Empty State Handling
Scenario: Show empty state when no results found
Given filters/search return zero results
When grid finishes loading
Then the system should display 'No Data Available' message
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should display 'No Data Available' message
The behavior should be validated when grid finishes loading.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Empty state icon visibility
when no data is available
test_cases.description:
Feature: Empty State Handling
Scenario: Empty state icon visibility
Given no data is available
When empty state renders
Then folder-with-X icon should be centered and visible
test_cases.acceptance:
Folder-with-X icon should be centered and visible
The behavior should be validated when empty state renders.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Grid hidden when empty
when loading is false and data length equals zero
test_cases.description:
Feature: Empty State Handling
Scenario: Grid hidden when empty
Given loading is false and data length equals zero
When page renders
Then grid component should not be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Grid component should not be displayed
The behavior should be validated when page renders.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Correct page number message
when no data exists for page 3
test_cases.description:
Feature: Empty State Handling
Scenario: Correct page number message
Given no data exists for page 3
When empty state displays
Then message should show 'not found on page 3'
test_cases.acceptance:
Message should show 'not found on page 3'
The behavior should be validated when empty state displays.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Clear Filter option accessible
when empty state is displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: Empty State Handling
Scenario: Clear Filter option accessible
Given empty state is displayed
When user wants to reset
Then Clear Filter or Reset option should remain clickable
test_cases.acceptance:
Clear Filter or Reset option should remain clickable
The behavior should be validated when user wants to reset.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Reset restores grid data
when empty state is visible
test_cases.description:
Feature: Empty State Handling
Scenario: Reset restores grid data
Given empty state is visible
When user clicks Reset
Then grid should reload and show available data
test_cases.acceptance:
Grid should reload and show available data
The behavior should be validated when user clicks Reset.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Fast empty state rendering
when dataset is empty
test_cases.description:
Feature: Empty State Handling
Scenario: Fast empty state rendering
Given dataset is empty
When rendering occurs
Then empty state should appear within acceptable time (<2s)
test_cases.acceptance:
Empty state should appear within acceptable time (<2s)
The behavior should be validated when rendering occurs.

test_cases.summary:
Verify No infinite loading
when API returns empty response
test_cases.description:
Feature: Empty State Handling
Scenario: No infinite loading
Given API returns empty response
When loading completes
Then spinner should disappear and empty state should show
test_cases.acceptance:
Spinner should disappear and empty state should show
The behavior should be validated when loading completes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Invalid filter input returns empty state
when user enters unmatched filter value
test_cases.description:
Feature: Empty State Handling
Scenario: Invalid filter input returns empty state
Given user enters unmatched filter value
When search executes
Then empty state should be displayed without errors
test_cases.acceptance:
Empty state should be displayed without errors
The behavior should be validated when search executes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Clear and readable message
when empty state appears
test_cases.description:
Feature: Empty State Handling
Scenario: Clear and readable message
Given empty state appears
When user reads message
Then text should be simple and understandable
test_cases.acceptance:
Text should be simple and understandable
The behavior should be validated when user reads message.

test_cases.summary:

Scenario: Freeze button visibility
Given the grid page is loaded
When the toolbar renders
Then the Freeze toggle button should be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
The Freeze toggle button should be visible
The behavior should be validated when the toolbar renders.
